title: analytics: the dataset draft preview answers [] for a runtimeFilter member spelled OBJECT.region that both live strategies resolve to the declared dimension
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28555 dev (PR #28686, os-dev-report `6558864662` on #28555), class a, measured. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade yet: a server seat grades it.

Reach: `queryDataset` with `previewDrafts: true`, measured. A `runtimeFilter` member spelled `OBJECT.region` resolves to the declared `region` on both live faces, which serve the `emea` rows; the preview answers `[]`, because it matches row keys as written. PR #28686 fixes the dimension spelling (`OBJECT.region` / `CUBE.region` as a dimension now previews live groups); the filter spelling is not covered, since it needs the where-tree members rewritten.

Business reason: a dashboard filter written with the object qualifier previews as empty and then returns rows after publish.

## Wanted

The preview resolves an object- or cube-qualified `runtimeFilter` member the way the live strategies do (one member resolution shared with the dimension face, not a second walker), or refuses it with the live refusal; never a silent `[]`.

## Dedupe

Searched open and closed issues for `preview runtimeFilter OBJECT`, `preview where cube prefix` and `previewDrafts OBJECT.region filter`: #28555 (open, dimension face), #28257 and #28201 (closed, undeclared member precedents). **New.**

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-analytics`, the draft-preview path).

Links back: #28555, #28557, PR #28686, #28257
